# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 89 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 89

**1** Jesus said: "Why do you clean only the outside of the cup? Don't you see that whoever made the inside also made the outside?"

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Clean only the outside" — the "only" emphasizes the selective cleaning as the problem
- "Don't you see" — more direct challenge than "do you not understand"
- "Whoever made" — the anonymous creator; the maker as universal principle
